facts.fact: Mulengera News reports NWSC's managing director saying its internal technical teams restored the utility's billing and electronic payment systems in roughly a day after a 2023 cyberattack because they understood how they were built.
facts.system: NWSC billing and electronic payment systems

facts.fact: Mulengera News reports NWSC's managing director saying the utility developed its billing system in house, with no contractor named.
Mulengera News reports NWSC's managing director saying the utility developed its electronic payment system in house, with no contractor named.
Mulengera News reports NWSC's managing director saying the utility developed its procurement, human resources and water-quality monitoring systems internally, with no contractor named.
facts.system: NWSC procurement, HR and water-quality systems
